name: random_cat
description: Get a random cat image. Returns image URL, cat ID, and associated tags.

name: cat_by_tag
description: Get a random cat image matching a specific tag (e.g., 'orange', 'cute', 'sleepy'). Returns image URL, cat ID, and tags.

tag.description: Tag to filter cats by (e.g. "cute", "orange", "grumpy"). Use list_tags to see available tags.

name: list_tags
description: List all available cat tags for filtering. Use tag names with cat_by_tag to find cats by appearance or behavior.
